name: Johnsoncab Electricals
summary: Johnsoncab Electricals makes low-voltage wires and cables up to 1.1 kV under the JOHNSON CABLES brand from two units in Mehsana, Gujarat, selling to private and government customers through tenders and vendor approvals. Revenue grew from ₹89 cr in FY24 to ₹211 cr in FY26 and profit rose 146% in FY26 to ₹13.4 cr, but operating cash flow was negative ₹19.7 cr in FY26 and borrowings more than doubled to ₹79.9 cr, a debt to equity of 2.54. The whole ₹56 cr issue is fresh money, about half of it for a new shed, machinery and a rooftop solar plant and ₹14 cr for working capital, with nothing for debt repayment. At the upper band the post-issue P/E is about 15.8x, below the 18.1x median of the listed peers named in the offer documents.

fh1.finding: Total income rose from ₹88.95 cr (FY24) to ₹211.34 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 54.1%.

fh2.finding: Revenue grew every year: ₹88.95 cr, ₹140.00 cr, ₹211.34 cr (FY24–FY26).

fh3.finding: Debt to equity was 2.54 in FY26 (borrowings ₹79.88 cr vs net worth ₹31.44 cr).

fh4.finding: Borrowings rose about 143% (₹32.81 cr to ₹79.88 cr) while total income rose about 138% over FY24–FY26.

fh5.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹8.88 cr, ₹14.24 cr, ₹31.44 cr (FY24–FY26).

fh6.finding: Operating cash flow was negative ₹19.70 cr in FY26, against a profit of ₹13.42 cr.

pr1.finding: Profit after tax grew about 146% in FY26, from ₹5.46 cr to ₹13.42 cr.

pr2.finding: Net margin improved from about 2.8% (FY24) to 3.9% (FY25) and 6.4% (FY26).

pr3.finding: Return on net worth was 42.68% in FY26 (ROE 58.75%), helped by the small equity base and high borrowing.

pr5.finding: Peer margins were not found in public sources.

va1.finding: Post-issue P/E of about 15.8x (₹211.42 cr market cap vs ₹13.42 cr FY26 profit) vs a peer median of 18.1x (JD Cables 11.6x, Susan Electricals 18.1x, Prime Cable 25.5x).

va2.finding: Post-issue price to book of about 2.4x (₹211.42 cr market cap vs about ₹87.5 cr net worth after the ₹56 cr issue) vs a peer median of 5.2x.

va3.finding: Peer market cap to sales figures were not found in public sources.

va4.finding: Rights issues in January and March 2026 allotted 2,70,000 shares at ₹140, 30% below the ₹200 upper band.

pg1.finding: Promoters hold about 73.5% after the issue, down from 100%.

pg2.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

pg3.finding: Total related-party transaction figures were not found; both plants are leased from promoters and promoters had lent ₹11.56 cr as of August 2026.

pg4.finding: No outstanding litigation, criminal or regulatory proceedings are reported against the promoters or directors.

is1.finding: The entire ₹56.02 cr issue is fresh; there is no offer for sale.

is2.finding: The issue is about 26.5% of the ₹211.42 cr post-issue market cap.

is3.finding: No selling shareholders, because there is no offer for sale.

up1.finding: ₹28.40 cr, about 50.7% of the issue, goes to a new factory shed, machinery and a rooftop solar plant.

up2.finding: None of the proceeds are earmarked for repaying debt.

up3.finding: The amount set aside for general corporate purposes was not found in public sources.

up4.finding: No proceeds go to repaying loans, so none repay promoter or group-company loans.

lg1.finding: No outstanding litigation against the company is reported; amounts are nil.

lg2.finding: No criminal or regulatory cases are reported against the company, promoters or directors.

lg3.finding: Contingent liabilities were not found in public sources.

rk1.finding: Top 10 customers gave 66.24% of FY26 revenue; the largest gave 18.35%.

rk2.finding: Top 10 suppliers were 49.30% of FY26 purchases, but the largest single supplier's share was not found.

rk3.finding: The company was incorporated in November 2020, about 6 years ago; the promoters' predecessor firm Johnson Cables dates from 2012.

rk4.finding: Auditor remarks were not found in public sources.
